ns2:course.label: Graduate Studio
ns2:course.description: Facilitate and model independently directed practice in the studio arts and related forms of cultural production, as well as the successful navigation of resources and opportunities within and outside of the University. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Course Information: May be repeated to a maximum of 4 hours in the same term and 10 hours in separate terms. Prerequisite: Restricted to Graduate Art majors.
